steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is shown.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, select the first Product cell, enter CYLINDER, choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB if offered, and verify Product Variant becomes Default Variant; enter Quantity Requested 10 and choose Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location; then enter no-such-product-xyz in the Product cell, verify no product option is offered, the row remains empty, and leave the screen showing that empty product row

steps.note: Perform and observe the product selection, dependent variant, quantity and location behavior, including rejection of the uncatalogued product.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Commit a valid event schedule before checking publication.
Add the required participant so the publication check isolates the missing product.
Assert that the event cannot be published while the product row is empty.
